title: The master session resume tests pass twenty times in a row on a loaded host
description: tests/master-session-resumes.test.ts runs twenty times, each beside tests/master-large-transcript-wake.test.ts, pinned to two CPU cores with two busy loops and the merge trial's per-file bound, and every run passes: the master session resumes after a loop restart, and its >2 GiB transcript is scanned once per read with padding never decoded, so host load cannot push it past the bound.

steps.name: twenty loaded runs beside another test file, on two cores
steps.run: taskset -c 0,1 sh -c 'for i in 1 2; do node -e "for(;;);" & busy="$busy $!"; done; status=0; for run in $(seq 20); do node --import tsx tests/helpers/run-tests.ts tests/master-session-resumes.test.ts tests/master-large-transcript-wake.test.ts || { status=1; echo "run $run failed"; break; }; done; kill $busy; exit $status'
